envelope.description: Terminal client: Services members and the settings modal

body.title: Terminal client: Services members and the settings modal
body.summary: Add catalog, repoSettings and setRepoSetting to Services.config (functions in src/cli/services/config.ts, wired in makeServices), the settings modal on the repos pane listing repoFields rows with local rows editable and policy and status rows read-only, and update the four Services fixtures.
acceptanceChecks: makeServices exposes the three members and the command, tui, services and team-service fixtures satisfy the interface
The modal shows the same labels and values as the shared payload, edits local rows including ghHost only, and shows the message of an ok:false result

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/settings-modal.test.ts: makeServices exposes catalog, repoSettings and setRepoSetting and the fixtures satisfy Services
src/cli/__tests__/settings-modal.test.ts: the modal lists payload rows, edits local rows only and shows an error message
